newsitem.title: USA: Cosby tells CBS wife wants son's killer -- soon.
newsitem.headline: Cosby tells CBS wife wants son's killer -- soon.

text.p: Entertainer Bill Cosby, who's son was murdered in Los Angeles earlier this month, told CBS on Sunday that his wife is concerned that the killer be captured -- soon.

Ennis Cosby was shot in the head as he changed a tire on a Los Angeles freeway early on the morning of Thursday, Jan. 16. A woman who saw part of the attack gave police a description of the killer as a white male wearing a knit cap, and that was used to put together a composite drawing of the suspect.
"There's a difference in this house," Cosby told CBS news. "Mrs Cosby wants this man. I mean she verbalizes she wants him. She wants him now."
"She refuses to accept the fact that this 'thing' is still out there," Cosby continued. "She doesn't accept the fact that nobody comes forward to help with the truth."
Cosby, a comedian, actor and author, told the network it is time for him to go back to work. He is the star of a situation comedy called "Cosby" which airs on CBS.

"I think it's time for me to tell the people that we have to laugh. We've got to laugh," Cosby said. "But I just want the people to know -- those who watch me, those who are with me -- it's over for looking at me to do anything but go back to that which I am."
Portions of the interview will be broadcast on CBS This Morning and the CBS Evening News on Monday, the network said.
Last week the supermarket tabloid the National Enquirer offered a $100,000 reward for information leading to the arrest and conviction of the killer.
The State of California is offering a $50,000 reward.
